deliberatelyTemporary.draugen_butterfly_uid: The only writer captures an NPC UID for a live scene; it is a handle for the current spawned entity, not durable quest progress, and should not survive logout.
deliberatelyTemporary.wanted_record_active: The record is a disposable private cutscene. The procedure clears the active marker during cleanup and logout queues that cleanup, so it is transient scene state.
deliberatelyTemporary.wanted_record_generation: The counter distinguishes callbacks while a private cutscene is active; the value has no meaning after the temporary scene/session ends.
deliberatelyTemporary.wanted_record_uid: Scene validity and cleanup compare this value with the live region UID, then cleanup clears it; it is a region handle, not lasting player progress.
deliberatelyTemporary.wanted_record_return: The coordinate exists only to return the player from the private cutscene and is consumed by cleanup; persisting it beyond that scene would be stale.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_spishyus_hint: The room-entry procedure and explicit reset set this to zero for a new room attempt, while the NPC interaction advances it from first hint to repeat hint. It is puzzle-room dialogue state rebuilt with the temporary room.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_hynn_state: Hynn’s state is initialized/reset by room lifecycle and used only to advance the room test; the room is self-contained and the run reset clears it.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_hynn_riddle: The riddle value is generated for the current test and reset on room initialization; it has no lasting effect outside that disposable room.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_hynn_uid: The UID binds callbacks to the active private region and is cleared on reset/exit; it is only a live-instance handle.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_ren: The puzzle values are initialized/reset when the room/run is rebuilt and govern only the current private-room attempt, so they need not outlive that instance.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_ren_uid: The value is assigned from the current region and cleared on setup/reset; it is a transient instance identity check.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_route_state: The route is selected for one private five-room run and explicitly cleared by run reset; active assessment recovery uses the separate permanent marker, so this state is rebuilt rather than persisted.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_route_uid: Route/room validity checks bind to this UID, and route reset clears it; it is only meaningful while that private region exists.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_death_active: The death lifecycle sets this only around death processing, consults it during cleanup, and then clears it; it is an ephemeral cleanup marker.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_tinley_state: Tinley’s state is initialized and reset with room/run setup and only advances the self-contained room test; it is rebuilt when the private room is entered.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_tinley_uid: The UID is captured from and validated against the active private region, then cleared by lifecycle cleanup; it is not player progress.
deliberatelyTemporary.rd_chem_tin_ore_taken: The chemistry room lifecycle resets this flag and the shelf sets it after giving the item; it prevents duplicate pickup only within the current disposable room instance.
deliberatelyTemporary.follower_uid: An NPC UID is only valid for the current spawned entity and is rebuilt when the follower is recreated; it is not durable character progress and must not survive logout.
deliberatelyTemporary.fenk_follower_uid: This UID only identifies the current spawned NPC; the follower is rebuilt and assigned a new UID after relog, so retaining the old value is not durable progress.
deliberatelyTemporary.mortton_current_shade: This is a short-lived current-burn selector, not a lasting quest or inventory record: the handler consumes it for that pyre interaction and clears it, so it should reset with the session rather than preserve a stale shade handle.
deliberatelyTemporary.temple_sanctity: The drain timer does not survive logout, so a saved pool would remain undrained. Period logout behaviour is UNKNOWN. Keep the temporary scope as an engineering choice.
deliberatelyTemporary.ghast_delay: This timestamp is meaningful only in the current map-clock/session and the delay rebuilds naturally; persisting it across logout would retain a stale cooldown rather than preserve lasting progress.
deliberatelyTemporary.mortmyre: This flag only prevents starting duplicate active decay timers and is cleared by the timer; it is transient runtime state, not a quest or reward record.

declarationReasons.barrows_generation: Saved run generation rejects stale owned actors and queued credit across logout, reset and the next run.
declarationReasons.barrows_countdowns: Saved Prayer and paid-collapse remainders resume after login without charging offline time or rearming a fresh interval.

declarationReasons.targetcount: Paid ranging competition shot count, including unclaimed finished-round marker. Resetting loses the paid round or permits extra shots.
declarationReasons.targetscore: Earned ranging competition points pending token payout. Clearing on logout loses the unclaimed reward.
declarationReasons.targethit: Last ranging-shot hit region, read immediately to calculate points and display the result before any suspension. Neither login nor payout reads it; the lasting score is separate.
declarationReasons.tai_bwo_cleanup: Cleanup introduction/repair progression, unclaimed favour points, payout slice maximum and villager visibility. Losing it discards earned favour or repeats progress.
declarationReasons.tai_bwo_villagerchat: Per-villager payout cooldown stages. Logout must not erase cooldowns and allow repeated shares of the same favour.
declarationReasons.warning_wilderness_teleport_lever: Player choice to suppress the Wilderness lever warning; the saved setting must remain selected.
declarationReasons.coal_truck: Coal deposited in the personal coal truck but not yet withdrawn. Losing it destroys deposited coal.
declarationReasons.beehive_free: Repellent applied to the beehive before wax collection. Retain the prepared hive so logout does not discard the completed preparation.
declarationReasons.rimmington_extras_var: Skippy cure stages and durable mogre combat unlock through the skippy_state varbit.
declarationReasons.goblin_caves: Personal swamp-cave knowledge, installed rope and lantern crafting unlock. Discarding it loses persistent preparation and access.
declarationReasons.ordinary_dialogue_bits: One-time Dromund/Dondakan conversation memories. Relog must not repeat the initial dialogue branch.
declarationReasons.farming_allotment_varp_1: Crop growth/harvest stages of allotment patches 1-4. Crops and their planted seed investment continue offline.
declarationReasons.farming_allotment_varp_2: Crop growth/harvest stages of allotment patches 5-8. Crops and their planted seed investment continue offline.
declarationReasons.farming_hops_varp: Crop growth/harvest stages of all four hop patches. Saving retains planted crops and yield.
declarationReasons.farming_flower_varp: Growth and harvest stages of all four flower patches, including neighbouring crop protection.
declarationReasons.varp511_bits: Contents and fermentation stages of compost bins. Saving retains deposited organic items and collectible compost.
declarationReasons.varp515_bits: Growth/harvest stages of the four herb patches. Resetting loses planted herbs and remaining harvest yield.

declarationReasons.farming_soil_lives: Remaining extra harvest lives from soil treatment. Saving retains the paid/applied treatment yield across harvests and relogs.

declarationReasons.seaslugquest: perm: multi-location quest progress and rescue gates.
declarationReasons.prieststart: perm: durable quest stage and completion.
declarationReasons.zombie_ogre: perm: quest completion and one-off quest actions persist.
declarationReasons.zombiequeen: perm: durable quest and tomb-access progress.
declarationReasons.sheep: perm: quest objective count and completion are durable.
declarationReasons.the_thing_sheared: perm: completed shearing action gates later quest dialogue.
declarationReasons.soulbane: perm: the base varp carries durable quest stage; room scripts reset transient puzzle state.
declarationReasons.onesmallfavour: perm: long NPC-handoff quest chain must persist.
declarationReasons.vampire: perm: quest stage is durable progress.
declarationReasons.troll_quest: perm: durable quest stage and outcome gates.
declarationReasons.troll_varbit: perm: one-off quest milestones and access gates.

declarationReasons.ibanmulti: perm: accumulated quest objectives and unlock flags.
declarationReasons.iban_staff_charges: perm: charges spent/recharged are lasting item state.
declarationReasons.main_ratcatch_var: Main classifies this as permanent quest progress by its readers. quests.rs2 reads the ratcatch_var bits 0-7 alias for quest points; cat naming reads the raw main_ratcatch_var base. There is no in-tree writer, so an ordinary account remains at zero and the naming gate silently refuses it.
declarationReasons.princequest: perm: durable quest-stage and rescue progress.
declarationReasons.prince_keystatus: perm: key-preparation and handoff progress must persist.
declarationReasons.treequest: perm: durable quest progression and objective gates.

declarationReasons.rd_hynn_state: temp: self-contained puzzle-room state is reset with the run.
declarationReasons.rd_hynn_riddle: temp: randomized room-attempt data is rebuilt on entry.
declarationReasons.rd_ren: temp: combination puzzle state is rebuilt with the room/run.
declarationReasons.rd_ren_uid: temp: current room UID is a transient handle.

declarationReasons.rd_assessment: perm: pending assessment/reward must survive login/logout; active-run recovery is explicit.
declarationReasons.rd_tiffy_introduced: perm: introduction/retry state is intentionally durable across visits.
declarationReasons.rd_death_active: temp: death-queue snapshot is consumed and cleared by cleanup.
declarationReasons.rd_tinley_state: temp: room-attempt puzzle state is rebuilt/reset.
declarationReasons.rd_tinley_uid: temp: private-room UID is a transient handle.
declarationReasons.rd_chem_tin_ore_taken: temp: one-room shelf pickup flag resets with the private room.
declarationReasons.handelmort_traps_disabled: perm: trap discovery/lock progress must survive logout.
declarationReasons.rag_quest: perm: collected quest objectives and completion are durable.
declarationReasons.rag_bone_2: perm: second-task item identity and boiler progress are durable across logout.
declarationReasons.troll_love: perm: durable quest stage across NPC/location handoffs.
declarationReasons.mcannon: Lawgof quest stage: rail/guard-tower tasks, cannon repair, return to the commander, and completion. Saving the stage preserves completed repairs and the handoff sequence; clearing it on logout would make the player repeat already-finished cannon tasks and can block the next dialogue.
declarationReasons.mcannonmulti: Per-cannon-part and railing bit flags used while repairing Lawgof’s cannon. These bits are the record of which railings and cannon pieces are already fixed; losing them would undo puzzle/repair progress after the player has done the work.
declarationReasons.dropcannon: Current assembly stage of the player’s placed dwarf multicannon (base, stand, barrels, full, or absent). The staged world cannon is resumable/recoverable state; resetting its stage on logout can make the already-placed cannon and its assembly materials inconsistent or lost.
declarationReasons.rockthrower: Number of cannonballs loaded in the player’s multicannon, decremented by firing and returned when the cannon is packed up. The count represents the player’s ammunition, not a session handle; clearing it on logout would discard cannonballs already loaded and prevent their return on pickup.
declarationReasons.ownedmcannon: Coordinate of the player’s owned/deployed multicannon, used by firing, setup, and pickup handlers. The coordinate is needed to locate, use, and recover the placed cannon after reconnecting; losing it would strand or lose the player’s cannon state.
declarationReasons.makinghistory: Making History master stage and active trader, warrior, and ghost subquest/presentation progress, including recorded object-location state. The saved subquest steps identify which records, journal, and memory tasks have already been completed; logout must not erase that evidence or send the quest back to earlier NPC tasks.
declarationReasons.ikov: Temple of Ikov quest stage and the player’s Armadyl-versus-Lucien progression. The branch and stage gate staff access, guardians, and quest rewards; clearing them on logout would undo the chosen path and already completed quest actions.
declarationReasons.ikov_dungeon: Temple of Ikov lever/bridge puzzle bits controlling opened dungeon routes. The flags are the puzzle’s current route state; losing them would close routes the player has already opened and erase completed lever work.
declarationReasons.ikov_icearrowchest_coord: Random coordinate of the replenishable ice-arrow chest cache; it is rerolled after arrows are found and is not used for quest completion. This is only the location of a temporary optional arrow cache. After a cache is collected the code chooses another location, and no quest step, item already paid into a task, or lasting reward depends on retaining the old coordinate; saving it across logout is unnecessary.
declarationReasons.heroquest: Hero’s Quest master stage, including the Black Arm/Phoenix branch steps and shared quest handoffs. This stage records which gang route and item/dialogue steps the player has completed; losing it would undo the branch and prevent the already-earned Hero’s Quest progress from resuming.
declarationReasons.blackarmgang: Black Arm gang stage, membership, and Shield of Arrav handoff/completion state. The value records gang membership and completed shield actions; resetting it would make the player repeat the Black Arm contribution or lose its completion state.
declarationReasons.phoenixgang: Phoenix gang stage, membership, and Shield of Arrav handoff/completion state. The value records gang membership and completed shield actions; resetting it would make the player repeat the Phoenix contribution or lose its completion state.
declarationReasons.dragonquest: Dragon Slayer main stage from map/ship preparation through sailing to Crandor and completion. The stage controls map-piece, ship, and Elvarg progression; resetting it would erase completed prerequisites and the final reward state.
declarationReasons.dragonquestvar: Count of Lady Lumbridge ship repairs, advanced up to the three repaired sections before sailing. The counter represents repair work already performed; losing it would roll back repairs and could make the player repeat work or materials before Ned can sail.
declarationReasons.dragon_ned_hired: Whether Captain Ned has agreed to sail the Lady Lumbridge for the player. This agreement is a prerequisite for the ship departure; losing it at logout would undo the hiring interaction after the player has arranged the voyage.
declarationReasons.dragon_oracle: Dragon Slayer Oracle knowledge and secret-door passage stage. The journal and door handlers use this to remember the Oracle clue and passage access; resetting it would erase an already learned route and prevent normal continuation.
declarationReasons.dragon_wall: Whether the Crandor secret passage has been discovered and remembered. The flag gates the secret door and the Dragon Slayer journal’s return-route text; clearing it would make the player lose the passage they already discovered.
declarationReasons.dragon_shield: Whether the player learned the Dragon Slayer anti-dragon-shield clue from Oziach. The journal and Duke dialogue depend on this learned prerequisite; resetting it would erase the player’s recorded clue and make the quest appear unfinished.
declarationReasons.dragon_goblin: Whether the player learned that Wormbrain holds the Dragon Slayer map piece. This flag gates Wormbrain’s map-piece interaction and the quest journal; clearing it would erase the clue needed to continue collecting the map.
declarationReasons.grail: Holy Grail quest stage, including Percival, the whistle, the Fisher King, and the Black Knight Titan outcome. The stage carries completed rescue and dialogue steps through to the Grail reward; clearing it would send the player back through already-finished stages.
declarationReasons.arthur: King Arthur quest stage and the Merlin/knights sequence. The stage determines which Arthur quest action is next and unlocks its reward; clearing it on logout would undo the completed rescue and dialogue work.
declarationReasons.excalibur_components_progress: Bitfield for the Excalibur/Merlin quest’s candle/altar steps, beggar dialogue, and reward state. The bits record puzzle items already supplied and whether the reward was issued; losing them would erase completed component work or make the reward handoff repeatable.
declarationReasons.arhein_crate_coord: Return coordinate saved while the player rides inside Arhein’s crate between the Catherby and Keep docks. The crate-exit handler teleports to this saved origin; retaining it preserves the player’s return position if they reconnect mid-trip, while clearing it can strand them at the ship or send them to the wrong dock.
declarationReasons.devious_base: Active Devious Minds progress fields for the monk, altar, and main quest stage. The values gate the monk’s help and altar interactions; resetting them would erase already-completed access and puzzle steps needed for the quest handoff.
declarationReasons.enakh_quest_expositbits: The active enakh_quest field: Enakh quest stage. The stage selects the next quest dialogue and objective; clearing it would make the player repeat completed Enakh steps and lose the route to the quest reward.
declarationReasons.cookquest: Cook’s Assistant stage, including requested ingredients and completion. The stage records whether the ingredient delivery and quest reward have already happened; resetting it would repeat the delivery or lose completion credit.
declarationReasons.myreque2_multivar: The active myreque_2_quest field: Myreque quest stage. The stage gates the next Myreque objective; clearing it would undo already completed dialogue/tasks and leave the player unable to resume at the correct step.
declarationReasons.drunkmonkquest: Monk’s Friend stage, including the water task and handover. The stage records the player’s completed water/monk actions; resetting it would require repeating the task and lose the original quest progression.
declarationReasons.mortton_current_shade: Shade remains type currently assigned to a funeral pyre while that burn is validated and rewarded; cleared after the reward. This is a short-lived current-burn selector, not a lasting quest or inventory record: the handler consumes it for that pyre interaction and clears it, so it should reset with the session rather than preserve a stale shade handle.
declarationReasons.temple_sanctity: Current temporary sanctity/resource pool for the Flamtaer temple, replenished by materials and drained by timers/actions. The drain timer does not survive logout, so a saved pool would remain undrained. Period logout behaviour is UNKNOWN. Keep the temporary scope as an engineering choice.
declarationReasons.spy: Black Knights’ Fortress quest stage, including the spying objectives and completion. The stage records which infiltration actions have been completed and gates the quest reward; clearing it would make those completed actions and quest credit disappear.
declarationReasons.elid_main: The active Elid quest stage plus the Shiratti, golem, and water-channel task flags. Those fields record recovered quest items and opened channels/golem routes; losing them would undo the player’s completed Elid tasks and block the statuette/reward sequence.
declarationReasons.crestquest: Family Crest quest stage and its family-member handoffs. The stage controls which family member and crest task is next; resetting it would erase already completed handoffs and the player’s route to the crest reward.
declarationReasons.crest_spells_levers_gauntlets: Family Crest puzzle bits for spell casts and levers, plus the selected gauntlets. The bits preserve completed puzzle steps and the player’s gauntlet choice; clearing them would make the player repeat the lever/spell puzzle or lose the chosen reward.
declarationReasons.forget_main_var: The active forget_quest field: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf stage. The main stage controls the quest’s next task and completion; clearing it would undo completed dialogue and item handoffs.
declarationReasons.hetty: Witch’s Potion quest stage, including the objects given to Hetty and completion. The value gates the potion ingredients and quest reward; losing it would make the player repeat the already completed ingredient handover.
declarationReasons.fairytale_multi: Fairy Tale Part I stage and the three nature items/Queen and Godfather check flags used by its quest handlers. These fields record which items and fairy NPC checks have already been completed; a reset would undo those steps and block continuation to the quest’s reward.
declarationReasons.fairy_gardeners_visited: Bitset of gardeners already visited during the Fairy Tale farmer task. The bits are the player’s completed gardener visits; losing them would erase task progress and make the player repeat the visits before the quest can advance.
declarationReasons.enchanted_key_hunt: Enchanted Key hunt-region discoveries and the stored heat/target value used to track the search. The bitset is the player’s accumulated search progress toward the key; clearing it would erase discovered regions and make the completed hunt work have to be repeated.
declarationReasons.ballquest: Witch’s House quest stage, including the magnet, mouse door, experiment, and completion. The stage preserves the door and experiment sequence and the quest reward; clearing it would make the player repeat completed puzzle and boss steps.
declarationReasons.grandtree: Grand Tree quest stage from Hazelmere’s clue through the Daconia-rock search and completion. The stage records completed clue and rescue steps; clearing it would undo the player’s quest progress and block the reward.
declarationReasons.daconia_rock_root: Random index selecting the one hidden Daconia root location for the active Grand Tree search. The search compares every root location to this saved index, and code sets it when Narnode assigns the search; losing it on logout would discard the target and can make the already-started objective unfindable.
declarationReasons.femi_help: Femi’s help/toll decision for using the Grand Tree entrance. The gate and Femi handlers distinguish declined help from accepted help using this choice; clearing it would lose the player’s recorded decision and can charge or deny the wrong route.
declarationReasons.death_equiproom: Death Plateau quest stage, including the combination/equipment-room door and completion. The stage records the map/combination and door work already done and gates quest rewards/access; losing it would undo the player’s completed puzzle steps.
declarationReasons.death_map: Two packed Death Plateau helper values accessed by death_get_map/set_map and death_get_bet/set_bet. The map/bet helpers read and write these player-specific fields during the quest; clearing them at logout would erase the stored map/bet state needed to continue the same task.
declarationReasons.death_bits: Death Plateau packed flags and numeric fields for Harold’s rolls/money/drunk state and Denulth’s map/combination handovers. The fields contain both the player’s tracked gambling money/roll outcomes and delivered quest-map items; losing them would erase the ongoing stakes or completed handovers.
declarationReasons.fluffs: Gertrude’s Cat quest stage from paying the boys and feeding Fluffs through kitten rescue and completion. The stage records paid clues, consumed feeding items, and the rescue state; clearing it would make the player repeat already-paid or consumed steps.
declarationReasons.fluffs_crate: Random coordinate of the hidden kitten crate selected after feeding Fluffs. The search and kitten-return handlers depend on this exact coordinate and do not regenerate it after logout; losing it would make the already-started kitten search fail to find its target.
declarationReasons.follower_obj: Named-object ID of the player’s current pet/cat type, used to restore the follower and prevent duplicate ownership. This persistent pet identity is the basis for restoring the right cat and checking the player’s inventory/bank; clearing it would lose the player’s current pet state.
declarationReasons.follower_uid: Live NPC UID for the currently spawned cat follower. An NPC UID is only valid for the current spawned entity and is rebuilt when the follower is recreated; it is not durable character progress and must not survive logout.
declarationReasons.cat_growth: Current pet’s packed hunger, attention, growth, and vermin counters. The growth and care values are the pet’s long-term state and feed the overgrown-cat/reward behavior; resetting them would erase the player’s accumulated pet development.
declarationReasons.lost_tribe: The active Lost Tribe quest stage. The stage gates access to the Dorgeshuun route and quest completion; clearing it would undo the player’s existing quest credit and progression.
declarationReasons.mourning_quest: Mourning’s End Part I quest stage. The stage records the player’s completed Mourner/Eluned steps and unlocks the next quest actions; clearing it would lose that progress.
declarationReasons.eadgar_grain: Number of grain units already handed into Eadgar’s quest task. The script consumes grain into this counter before the quota is met; resetting it would lose the player’s contributed items and require them to supply the grain again.
declarationReasons.eadgar_chickens: Number of raw chickens already handed into Eadgar’s quest task. The script consumes chickens into this counter before the quota is met; resetting it would lose the player’s contributed items and require them to supply the chickens again.
declarationReasons.junglepotion: Jungle Potion stage and ordered identification/handover of the five herbs. The stage records which herbs the player has found and identified; clearing it would undo item-identification work and lose the quest’s completion route.
declarationReasons.murderquest: Murder Mystery main stage from accepting the case through the final arrest/reward. The stage gates interviews, evidence submission, and the final reward; clearing it would undo a solved case or force the player to restart it.
declarationReasons.murder_poisonproof_progress: Progress through the poison-proof interviews and case conclusions. The value controls which suspects and proof options remain available; clearing it would erase completed interviews and prevent the player from presenting the same case correctly.
declarationReasons.murder_evidence: Evidence bitset for found thread, fingerprints, and other Murder Mystery evidence. The bits represent evidence the player has collected and can hand to the guard; losing them would invalidate completed searches and the final proof.
declarationReasons.murdersus: Randomly selected murderer/suspect identity assigned once when the player accepts the case. Interviews, poison clues, and the final accusation all use this same selected suspect; losing it would make the already gathered evidence inconsistent or change the answer after logout.
declarationReasons.druidquest: Druidic Ritual quest stage through Sanfew’s ingredient handover and completion. The stage controls the herb handover and quest credit; resetting it would undo the already completed preparation and reward.
declarationReasons.haunted: Ernest the Chicken quest stage, including manor tasks and completion. The stage gates the manor puzzle and rescue sequence; clearing it would make the player redo already completed tasks.
declarationReasons.ernestlever: Current positions/progress of Ernest’s Manor lever puzzle. Main's favourable reading: preserve lever progress across a mid-puzzle logout; room ladder entry/exit explicitly resets the puzzle. UNKNOWN whether the period game retained lever state across logout.
declarationReasons.haunted_manor_fountain_poisoned: Whether the manor fountain has been poisoned for Ernest’s quest. The manor quest checks this event as completed; clearing it would undo the poisoned-fountain step and force the player to repeat it.
declarationReasons.imp: Imp Catcher quest stage and completion. The stage records the beads/quest handoffs and reward; resetting it would erase the player’s completed collection and completion credit.
declarationReasons.handsand: Hand in the Sand quest stage and active question/teleport/serum answer flags. The values record answers and item steps the quest has already accepted; clearing them would undo completed puzzle/interview work and lose the reward route.
declarationReasons.hazeelcultquest: Hazeel Cult quest stage through side task, decision, and reward. The stage gates the next NPC/object interactions and quest reward; clearing it would undo the player’s completed cult tasks.
declarationReasons.hazeelcult_valves: Bitset of the current Hazeel sewer-valve positions. The valve puzzle reads these positions to decide whether the water route is solved; resetting them would undo the player’s completed valve configuration.
declarationReasons.hazeelcult_side: The chosen Hazeel Cult good/evil side. The NPC dialogue, quest steps, and reward branch depend on this decision; clearing it could change the player’s chosen side after they have committed to it.
declarationReasons.biohazard: Biohazard main quest stage from Elena’s outbreak through the distillator and completion. The stage records consumed items, released pigeons, disguise, and distillator handoffs; clearing it would make the player repeat completed Biohazard steps.
declarationReasons.bioerrand: Per-NPC Biohazard errand bits for samples given and whether each answer was correct or wrong. The bits preserve which samples/errands the player has already completed and the correct/wrong result; clearing them would erase consumed sample work and alter later dialogue.
declarationReasons.biodummy: Number of combat-training hits already made on the Biohazard camp dummy, capped at six XP awards. This is the persistent per-character training cap; resetting it would erase the recorded awards and let logout reopen the already-used training allowance.
declarationReasons.desertrescue: Desert Rescue main stage from Bedabin infiltration through freeing and extracting Ana and choosing rewards. The stage tracks completed rescue actions and item handoffs; clearing it would undo the mission progress and can lose the rescue/reward state.
declarationReasons.desertrescue_map_mechanisms: Desert Rescue mechanism bits for Al Shabim/tent access, distractions, and Ana’s minecart/lift route. The flags are the solved access and rescue mechanisms that complement the main stage; clearing them would undo the player’s completed puzzle/access work.
declarationReasons.scorpius_given_symbol: Whether the player has already handed the required symbol to the Spirit of Scorpius. The spirit checks this flag to continue its dialogue after the handover; clearing it would lose the recorded item delivery and require the player to repeat or reacquire the symbol.
declarationReasons.itgronigen: Observatory quest stage for supplying telescope materials, sending the telescope, and claiming wine. The stage remembers consumed construction materials and the telescope/wine handoffs; clearing it would undo those deliveries and lose the quest reward state.
declarationReasons.itkeepgatelock: Whether the observatory keep gate lock has been opened for the player. The gate handler uses this flag to retain access after unlocking; clearing it would relock a route the player has already opened.
declarationReasons.fever_quest: Main Fever quest stage, advanced by the teacher interaction and used by the quest list. The quest list and NPC access read this stage; clearing it would erase the player’s completed start/progression and block the proper continuation.
declarationReasons.main_feud_var: The Feud main stage plus active mayor/boss/trait/jewel dialogue flags. The values preserve the Feud’s already completed gang, mayor, and boss actions; clearing them would undo quest steps and item handoffs.
declarationReasons.feud_var_multi: Feud side-task state for gang talks/competitions, drink, urchin, mayor door/safe, hag, distractions, and Ali’s money. These fields record solved safe digits and task/item handoffs across several NPCs; resetting them would erase the actual work needed to advance the Feud.
declarationReasons.barcrawl: Barcrawl completion stage and per-bar bit flags written onto the player’s barcrawl card. The bits prevent repeated drinking and show which bars have stamped the card; clearing them would erase completed bar visits and block the access reward.
declarationReasons.legendsquest: Legends’ Quest main stage from map/cavern preparation through the final battles and completion. The stage carries the player through the required map and combat milestones to the quest reward; clearing it would undo completed stages and boss progress.
declarationReasons.legends_bits: Legends’ Quest flags for jungle-map sections, runes/gems, bowl uses, crystal smelting, bosses, dagger handoff, and item use. The bits record collected puzzle evidence and defeated bosses as well as spent quest items; losing them would erase completed Legends tasks and can strand the final sequence.
declarationReasons.fishingcompo: Fishing Contest main stage, including contest entry, win, completion, trophy recovery, and tunnel access. The stage records the player’s trophy/reward and the unlocked White Wolf Mountain route; clearing it would lose completion credit and access after the contest is won.
declarationReasons.hemenster_comp_stage: Fishing Contest paid-entry state and number of fish caught in the active three-fish round. The player has paid the 5-coin entry fee and can have fish counted into this state; clearing it would discard the paid entry/round progress and force a new payment.
declarationReasons.hemenster_pipe_stashed: Whether garlic has been stashed in the Hemenster pipe, moving the competition’s fishing assignment. Bonzo’s placement handler relies on this persistent effect to assign the pipe-side spot; losing it would undo the player’s completed setup and change the contest route.
declarationReasons.itexamlevel: Archaeological exam progress level, advanced only when the submitted progress is higher. The level records passed exam steps and is checked for later access; clearing it would revoke completed exam progress and block Desert Treasure prerequisites.
declarationReasons.itexam_errands: Two-bit progress values for the archaeological examiner’s individual errands. The values record which errand tasks have already been completed; clearing them would make the player repeat those errands and lose exam progress.
declarationReasons.itexam_bits: Bit flags for completed archaeological exam checks. The exam reads these flags to preserve passed checks; resetting them would erase already earned exam credit and block the permit/access step.
declarationReasons.agrith_quest_varp: The active Agrith-Na-Na quest stage and Badden Uzer task flag. The stage and task flag control the ritual NPC sequence; clearing them would undo the player’s completed Uzer/quest steps and reward path.
declarationReasons.mdaughter_var: Mountain Daughter stage plus mud/food/relation, bear encounter, Ragnar necklace, and burial state fields. The fields preserve item contributions, bear discovery/combat, relationships, and the burial sequence; clearing them would undo those completed tasks and can lose supplied items.
declarationReasons.dwarfrock_main: Between a Rock… stage plus active information, gold-cannonball, and engineer-visit fields. The quest uses these values for the cannonball and Dondakan sequence; clearing them would erase delivered materials and completed forge/engineer steps.
declarationReasons.demonstart: Demon Slayer stage, including the bones and silverlight-key collection sequence. The counter and stages record the player’s completed Traiborn/key steps; clearing them would undo collected quest progress and delay Silverlight/Delrith completion.
declarationReasons.golem_quest: Golem quest stage and statuette puzzle state, including clay, notes, doors, throne gems, and statuette recovery. The fields preserve the player’s completed underground/puzzle and statuette actions; clearing them would erase the solution and the quest reward route.
declarationReasons.garden_varp_1: Garden quest stage and the active Elstan, Lyra, and Kragen gardener-task flags. These flags retain the player’s gardener interactions and quest stage; clearing them would make already completed garden tasks repeat and roll back quest progress.
declarationReasons.ahoy_varbits_1: The active ahoy_questvar field: quest stage read and advanced by the Ahoy quest handlers. The stage controls the next quest dialogue and completion state; clearing it would undo completed quest actions. Other declared packed names have no current script references.
declarationReasons.deal_quest: Deal quest stage advanced by Pete and read by the quest list. The stage is the saved completion/progression record used by Pete and the quest list; clearing it would erase the player’s completed Deal steps and credit.
declarationReasons.godbook_multi: Horror from the Deep claimed-book, page, and reclaim state plus the Viking quest’s packed random name fields. Page and claim/reclaim bits preserve book progress and recoverable book rewards; resetting them would erase pages/claims. The packed Viking name also remains stable for the player.
declarationReasons.doricquest: Doric’s Quest stage for the requested ores and completion. The stage records ore handover and quest reward credit; clearing it would make the player repeat the item delivery.
declarationReasons.main_ics_var: The active ics_little_var field: Icthlarin’s Little Helper quest stage. The stage gates the desert quest and carpet access; clearing it would erase the player’s completed Icthlarin quest step and completion credit.
declarationReasons.chompybird: Chompy Bird Hunting quest stage. The stage gates the Chompy tasks and quest reward; clearing it would erase the player’s quest completion/progression.
declarationReasons.chompybird_kills: Cumulative Chompy kills plus the count/flags used for kill milestones and chompy gear/tool tasks. The counter drives kill-hat milestones and the player’s earned Chompy progress; clearing it would erase accumulated kills and delay those rewards.
declarationReasons.cogquest: Clock Tower quest stage bits and the poisoned-rat-trough door flag. The bits retain the player’s quest step and opened rat-door state; clearing them would undo puzzle progress and the route through the quest.
declarationReasons.fenk_follower_uid: Live NPC UID of the creature currently following the player during the Fenkenstrain gardener sequence. This UID only identifies the current spawned NPC; the follower is rebuilt and assigned a new UID after relog, so retaining the old value is not durable progress.
declarationReasons.fenk_charos_unlocked: Whether the player unlocked Charos after Creature of Fenkenstrain. This unlock is persistent character access/progression; clearing it would remove the player’s earned Charos option after completing the quest.
declarationReasons.hunt: Hunt quest main stage, including the note and completion state. The stage records the player’s received clue and quest completion; clearing it would erase the already-earned quest progress and reward access.
declarationReasons.hunt_store_employed: Employment/task bits for Luthas’s banana plantation and Wydin’s grocery store. The bits gate access and distinguish completed employment/smuggling actions; clearing them would erase the player’s job/access and make the store task repeat.
declarationReasons.crate_bananas: Number of bananas already deposited in Luthas’s shipping crate toward the ten-banana payment. Bananas are counted after deposit and the counter is cleared only when Luthas pays; a logout reset would lose the deposited fruit and its pending 30-coin reward.
declarationReasons.crate_rum: Rum smuggling state: bottle collected, hidden in the banana crate, shipped, then reclaimed from Wydin. The state links the player’s consumed/moved rum bottle to the shipped crate; clearing it would lose the smuggling progress or make the recoverable rum item unavailable.
declarationReasons.ghast_delay: Last map-clock tick used to enforce the 26-tick ghast attack cooldown. This timestamp is meaningful only in the current map-clock/session and the delay rebuilds naturally; persisting it across logout would retain a stale cooldown rather than preserve lasting progress.
declarationReasons.mortmyre: Active swamp-decay timer flag in the Mort Myre area. This flag only prevents starting duplicate active decay timers and is cleared by the timer; it is transient runtime state, not a quest or reward record.
declarationReasons.druidspirit: Nature Spirit quest stage through the nature/spirit stones and ritual. The stage gates the stone and ritual handoffs; clearing it would undo completed items and quest credit.
declarationReasons.druidspirit_bits: Nature Spirit bit flags for obtaining the nature stone and spirit stone. The bits record quest stones already collected and are read by the journal and ritual; clearing them would erase completed item steps and block the ritual.
declarationReasons.mourning_quest_part2: Mourning’s End Part II main quest stage. The stage gates the Mourner/Temple route and completion state; clearing it would undo the player’s completed quest progress and access.
